reason: Nobody in my street or family has used this yet, and I'm not handing a stranger money through an app before I ask around first -- that's just how I do things, even for a fifty-rupee job.
objection: Is this app actually in Tamil, or just translated labels with English support underneath -- and has anyone I actually know booked through it and gotten a good result?
would_change_my_mind: If a neighbour or relative had already used hithozha and told me the Tamil was proper and the freelancer showed up and did good work, I'd try it for one small job to test it myself.
